headline.text: L2 ML3 ramp conveyor and blow-offs caused *multiple stoppages* through 1st shift — still troubleshooting by handoff

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran caramel cluster all day with temper struggles on Sollich 2 — team dialed it in by mid-2nd shift after melting tank temp fix and new caramel batch. Sollich 3 finished mac nut run and went down at 05:51 after running out of chocolate.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 ML3 fought ramp conveyor and blow-off issues from startup through end of 1st shift — multiple stops, some progress by 15:04 but recurring. ML2 cleared several quick jams and released 180 quarantined caramel barrels. FFS replaced damaged seal bar with original as temp fix.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ML4 had 6 mold jams in demolding overnight — root cause identified as east plow rail misalignment, corrected by 04:52. Truffle bottomer wire took 3 hours to repair, cleared by 04:43. ML1 reported torn C1 belt.

notes.text: All 180 FEA caramel barrels (21117) released from quarantine after Charity approval at 07:09.
Air compressor capacity hit limit when running FFS, sorting, ML3, and mold blow-dry at once — resolved by staggering loads.
13 LPNs of caramel lot 61H16X161H on hold for foreign material (item 10256).
3 pallets of expired chocolate (10102) extended 30 days after QA inspection.

resolved.title: Sollich 2 chocolate tempering out of range after melting tank misconfiguration
resolved.summary: Melting tank set to 60°C (should be 52°C) caused buffer tank to overheat, pushing mini temper out of spec through morning — team brought temps down and stabilized by 16:26.
resolved.resolution: Lowered melting tank to 52°C, cycled through reheat, adjusted mini temper settings — temper steady below 1.0 by 16:26 per Elizabeth Hernandez.

resolved.title: Sollich 2 caramel viscosity well below spec (5k vs 19k target)
resolved.summary: First batch tested at 5,000 cP against 19,000 target — all ingredients and cook temp (238°F) correct, no equipment issue found.
resolved.resolution: Scrapped low-viscosity batch, cooked new batch at 238°F — subsequent tests in acceptable range per Jorel at 21:22.

resolved.title: MM8 printer screen malfunctioned
resolved.summary: Screen failure on MM8 printer — borrowed MM5 printer to continue, cable repaired but unit still needs tech visit.
resolved.resolution: Cable repaired at 08:21 per Chris Jeffs — running on borrowed MM5 printer, tech visit scheduled.

resolved.title: Mac nut pallet with undersized pieces
resolved.summary: One pallet labeled for Costco contained very small pieces outside spec — caught during production.
resolved.resolution: Pallet removed from line and placed on hold, QA notified at 19:30 per William Beattie.

resolved.title: 3 pallets of chocolate (10102) expired
resolved.summary: Operator discovered 3 pallets past printed expiration date before use — slight bloom visible but otherwise good condition.
resolved.resolution: QA inspected, extended expiration 30 days per Angelica Perez at 22:04 — approved for use.

resolved.title: FFS tape machine not sealing boxes
resolved.summary: Tape machine failure at 15:40 preventing box sealing.
resolved.resolution: Working fine at 15:46 per Brandon Lance — 6-minute stop.

resolved.title: Air compressors unable to keep up with demand
resolved.summary: Running FFS, sorting, ML3, and blow-drying molds simultaneously exceeded compressor capacity — shutting down ML3 and FFS intermittently at 16:43.
resolved.resolution: Staggered air usage, stopped blow-dry hoses — under control and running at 17:52 per Alan Todd.

resolved.title: ML2 caramel tank leak
resolved.summary: Leak detected on caramel tank requiring maintenance repair.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance repaired leak at 22:24 per Gustavo Rodas.

resolved.title: 180 caramel barrels (21117) in quarantine status loaded by mistake
resolved.summary: 3 barrels loaded on 2nd shift plus 2 on 3rd shift were all quarantine status — 180 of 191 total barrels quarantined, only 8 OK barrels available.
resolved.resolution: After Charity verification, all FEA barrels released from quarantine at 07:09 per Hervin Herrera.

resolved.title: FFS side seal bar damaged
resolved.summary: Side seal bar failure at 04:06 requiring replacement.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance installed original sealer bar as temporary fix, holding at 04:16 per Zack Kurtz.

resolved.title: ML2 bars jamming at flow wrap entrance
resolved.summary: Bars stacking at FW entrance causing line stoppage at 04:07.
resolved.resolution: Line up at 04:23 per Gustavo Rodas — 16-minute stop.

resolved.title: Panning conveyor stuck with product buildup
resolved.summary: Low-profile panning conveyor not running — belt stuck with product and powder.
resolved.resolution: Cleared and running at 05:21 per Dave Ruff — belt just needed cleaning.

resolved.title: ML2 nozzle clog causing broken bars
resolved.summary: Single nozzle clogged on depositor, generating broken-bar scrap at 22:13.
resolved.resolution: Clog cleared by 22:20 per Gustavo Rodas — one bar affected.

resolved.title: ML2 white rail misaligned on blue packaging belt
resolved.summary: Packaging belt white rail out of position, line stopped for adjustment at 22:29.
resolved.resolution: Line back up at 22:31 — 2-minute stop per Gustavo Rodas.

resolved.title: ML2 deflector hitting belt on packaging line
resolved.summary: Line stop deflector making contact with belt at 06:20.
resolved.resolution: Line running at 06:23 per ML2 FW — 3-minute stop.

resolved.title: ML4 mold jams in demolding area (6 incidents overnight)
resolved.summary: Recurring mold jams at demolding turner — 6 jams between 01:07 and 04:44, excessive chocolate buildup from scraper leaving residue.
resolved.resolution: Root cause identified as east side plow rail misalignment causing chocolate buildup — corrected, last jam cleared at 04:52 per Kimberly Morales.

resolved.title: ML4 gondola jams at discharge (multiple)
resolved.summary: Gondola jam at 12:59, chocolate packed under belt causing belt misalignment — second jam at 16:18 requiring belt realignment.
resolved.resolution: Cleaned front end and trays, started back up at 18:45 per Shane Olsen — ran well rest of shift.

resolved.title: ML4 TG5 blue belt jamming from rotation issues
resolved.summary: Blue belt on Theegarten 5 causing jams when rotating — small belt piece found at shift start indicating potential FM risk.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance replaced belt, washed for ATP, installed and verified — running normally at 00:06 per ML4 TG.

resolved.title: Truffle bottomer wire needs repair
resolved.summary: Bottomer wire issue blocking truffle line startup at 01:37 — maintenance working, called Nathan from L1 to assist with training.
resolved.resolution: Repair complete at 04:43 per Alan Greer — 3-hour repair with cross-plant help.

resolved.title: ML4 discharge belt misaligning bars (M2 conveyor)
resolved.summary: Belt M2 on discharge misaligning chocolate bars, generating scrap at 00:15.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance assisted, capture test correct at 00:18 per Janeth Sanchez.

needs_attention.title: Cluster Cases (40964) short for Thursday start — need 12,800, have 3,248
needs_attention.summary: Scheduled to start cluster production Thursday, BOM calls for 12,800 boxes but only 3,248 in stock.
needs_attention.status: Question posted to planning at 02:27, no receipt date or supply plan confirmed.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 bag count inventory discrepancy of 751 units
needs_attention.summary: System shows 12,219 bags but physical count is 11,468 — difference of 751 bags reported to IMS at 09:08.
needs_attention.status: Discrepancy reported to IMS, no adjustment or root cause identified as of 10:35.

needs_attention.title: L1 second floor HVAC feels humid and sticky
needs_attention.summary: Upstairs environment uncomfortable, possible HVAC issue at 09:55.
needs_attention.status: William Lopez acknowledged at 12:35, no update on inspection or findings.

needs_attention.title: Chocolate depositor melting tank cold after power trip
needs_attention.summary: Main power switch tripped during earlier power outage — melting tank cold, chocolate solidified, needs time to reheat and melt.
needs_attention.status: Still heating to melt chocolate block as of 15:46 — won't be used in near future per William Beattie.

needs_attention.title: Multiple areas need repair (photos posted)
needs_attention.summary: Ebrima posted photos of areas needing maintenance fixes at 02:26, tagged Jody and Brandon.
needs_attention.status: Photos posted, no maintenance response or work plan as of window close.

needs_attention.title: ML3 ramp conveyor and blow-offs causing repeated line stops
needs_attention.summary: Ramp conveyor moving up/down randomly, excessive blow-offs past metal detector — line stopped multiple times from 08:04 through 10:55 on 1st shift, CIL performed at 10:55.
needs_attention.status: Packaging running better at 11mpm by 15:04 per Alan Todd after Raymond made changes, but recurring stops reported through shift end — dialing in continues.

needs_attention.title: FFS blow-off nozzles struggling, causing zero errors
needs_attention.summary: Nozzles not blowing off bags properly, generating zero errors at 22:50 — maintenance adjusting.
needs_attention.status: Nozzles being adjusted by maintenance as of 22:51, second zero error occurred — no confirmation of fix.

needs_attention.title: ML2 caramel cannot be entered into system, status needs changing
needs_attention.summary: Chocolate adjustment blocked — caramel status preventing system entry at 01:03.
needs_attention.status: Escalated to Alan Todd, Nidia, Sofia, Gustavo, Zack at 01:03 — no status change or workaround confirmed.

needs_attention.title: ML4 caramel lot 61H16X161H on hold for foreign material (13 LPNs)
needs_attention.summary: FM found in caramel item 10256 this morning — lot 61H16X161H placed on systematic hold, 13 LPNs total.
needs_attention.status: 13 LPNs on hold and labeled per Angel Cabrera as of 22:50, no investigation findings or disposition.

needs_attention.title: ML1 C1 belt torn
needs_attention.summary: C1 belt torn, maintenance aware at 00:45.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance aware as of 00:45 per Raoul Lubain, no repair update through window close.

needs_attention.title: Chocolate melting tank door not closing properly from heat
needs_attention.summary: Door fails to close properly, heat-related warping — recurring issue at 17:02.
needs_attention.status: No solution found yet per Chad Stone at 21:24 — still working on it.

needs_attention.title: Product staging area has 20+ pallets of returns and incorrect staging
needs_attention.summary: Had to move over 20 pallets of product returns and incorrect staging — no standard being followed.
needs_attention.status: Pallets moved, escalated to Chad, Rose, Alan, Rich, Marcos, Tyson, Frederick at 05:46 — need to establish standard.

needs_attention.title: Truffle nose bar rollers starting to wear, rough spots developing
needs_attention.summary: Some M3 conveyor nose bar rollers showing rough spots but none seized yet — measurements taken to order replacements.
needs_attention.status: Parts being ordered for replacement and stock per Kavin at 06:39, no timeline for install.
